art_direction: 原创成年人物半身石雕被布褶包围，面部平静，白大理石纹理细腻。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Render an original marble bust of an adult person with a calm, slightly turned face and simplified short hair. A broad folded cloth wraps the shoulders, forming deep but orderly channels that frame the face. Use warm white marble with restrained gray veining, polished on the face and slightly matte within the folds. Place the bust against muted slate-blue, illuminated by a high side window. Show enough detail in lips, eyelids, chisel-softened edges, and cloth transitions to reward close viewing without imitating a historical sculpture. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for clear original focal composition, requested medium and detail level, circular-crop readability, no unintended anatomy or rendering defects, no text or watermark
